name: sccfm
description: Install, configure, remove, and safely operate Cisco SCC Firewall Manager from AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Set up and safely operate SCC Firewall Manager
interface.longDescription: Guides installation, authentication, and safe teardown; discovers the live sccfm-cli and cisco.sccfm Ansible schemas; executes verified read-only operations; and gates mutating operations behind an explicit reviewed plan.
defaultPrompt: Set up SCC Firewall Manager for this machine.
Check whether my SCCFM CLI and Ansible setup is healthy.
List my SCCFM devices using a read-only operation.
Completely uninstall SCCFM from this machine.
